intro.title: Coin Change
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that solves the Coin Change problem, which calculates the minimum number of coins needed to make a specific amount of money given a set of coin denominations. You will learn the core concept of dynamic programming, a technique for solving complex problems by breaking them down into simpler subproblems and storing their solutions. The main technologies and constructs involved are JavaScript functions, arrays, loops, and conditional logic. By the end, you will understand how to implement an efficient algorithm to find the optimal coin combination for any given amount.
intro.usecase: The Coin Change algorithm is essential in financial and payment systems where exact change calculation is required. Developers implement this pattern in point-of-sale systems to determine the minimum number of coins/bills needed for cash transactions, in vending machines to optimize coin dispensing, and in banking apps for currency conversion with limited denominations. It also appears in e-commerce platforms when calculating optimal coupon or reward point combinations, and in budgeting tools that help users allocate funds across different expense categories efficiently.
